room_rent.note: Room rent inclusive of boarding, nursing, RMO charges. ICU at 3% of SI/day max ₹20,000.

copayment.note: Mandatory 25% co-payment on all claims. Not applicable on cataract sub-limit, repatriation of mortal remains, home care treatment, major disease sub-limits, and optional covers 16 & 17. Optional modification available: reduce to 20% (5% premium loading) or increase to 30% (5% premium discount).

sub_limits.display: Many sub-limits: cataract, surgeon fees, modern treatments, major diseases
sub_limits.note: Cataract: ₹35,000/eye, ₹50,000/policy year. Surgeon/specialist fees: 35% of SI per hospitalisation. Other medical expenses: 60% of SI per hospitalisation. Modern treatments: 50% of SI. Home care: 5% of SI or ₹1L whichever less. Major disease sub-limits (neurological, heart, cancer, renal, major surgeries) vary by SI. Pre/post hospitalisation combined max ₹10,000 for 30 days. Road ambulance: ₹2,500/hospitalisation, ₹5,000/policy year.

deductible.note: Optional voluntary aggregate deductible available: ₹25,000 (10% discount), ₹50,000 (15% discount), ₹1,00,000 (20% discount).

initial_waiting.note: Not applicable for accidents. Waived if continuously covered for more than 12 months.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 12 months from first policy inception with insurer.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Applies to listed conditions including cataract, ENT diseases, thyroid, hernia, joint replacements, spine diseases, gynaecological conditions, prostate, transplants, congenital internal diseases, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Code Excl 18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording.

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording.

pre_hosp.note: Pre and post hospitalisation combined maximum is 30 days subject to ₹10,000 total.

post_hosp.note: Pre and post hospitalisation combined maximum is 30 days subject to ₹10,000 total.

day_care.display: All day-care procedures covered up to SI

domiciliary.note: Home care treatment covered up to 5% of SI or ₹1,00,000 whichever is less, for specified conditions only.

ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient hospitalisation covered up to sum insured. Yoga and Naturopathy require prior company approval.

organ_donor.note: All types of transplant and related surgeries are listed under the 24-month specific disease waiting period exclusion list.

ambulance.note: Covers transport to hospital, hospital-to-hospital transfer, and hospital-to-residence (if certified by doctor, same city).

modern_treatments.note: Covers robotic surgeries, immunotherapy, stem cell therapy, intravitreal injections (max 3/eye/policy year), deep brain stimulation, and other listed modern treatments.

consumables.note: Optional Cover 14: consumables from List I covered up to SI if opted. Also covers admission/registration, record and insurance processing charges.

global_cover.note: Territorial limit: all treatments must be taken in India.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim can be contested except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 15 days for monthly instalment mode and 30 days for all other modes.

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only, not on renewals or porting/migration.

portability.note: Credits for PED waiting, specific waiting periods, NCB, moratorium transferable to new insurer.

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, dental (unless accident), STDs (except HIV/AIDS), circumcision, congenital external defects, experimental therapies, hazardous sports, gender change, obesity surgery (unless criteria met)

optional_riders.display: Consumables cover, Voluntary Aggregate Deductible, Supportive Care (Rehab/Pain Mgmt + Hospice), Recovery & Enrichment Care (Assisted Living + Nursing at Home), Co-payment modification
